candidates.snippet: @flightradar24 NOTAM issued just a few hours before the shutdown asks pilots to be on the lookout for drones: https://t.co/oTB2kjh9kF

Numerous flights into Luxembourg Airport were forced to hold or diverted tonight after the airfield was shut down due to unknown drone activity. 

Comes after a series of Russian grey-zone drone incidents at other sensitive European sites. https://t.co/6UkNKyAtLF
